description: The Cartan developing-map route to unit-curvature sphere recognition. Everything from the two joint-uniformity obligations H1 and H2 to the universal recognition statement is checked; H1 and H2 remain open. Their fixed-anchor slices are proved from constant curvature; the joint neighborhoods as anchors and alignments move on the compact diagonal are not.

references.role: Closure record for the F-transition law and the definition of the H1/H2 boundary.

nodes.description: H1: for every unit-curvature metric on every closed simply connected smooth 3-manifold, the differential-induced successor data locus is a neighborhood of the parameter diagonal (joint in source anchor, target anchor, and alignment). Only fixed-anchor vertical slices are proved (universalSuccessorDataLocus_vertical_mem_nhds_of_curvature).

H2: for every unit-curvature metric on every closed simply connected smooth 3-manifold, the locus where the old germ equals the successor germ is a neighborhood of the parameter diagonal. Only the fixed-anchor datum-dependent-radius version is proved (fixedAnchorActualSuccessorEqualityNeighborhood_of_constantCurvature).

Checked conditional reduction: H1 and H2 realize rooted chains with whole-cell mesh control, hence a restricted compatible Cartan atlas, hence a total local developing map, hence the sphere homeomorphism by covering rigidity.
Universal unit-curvature sphere recognition (Killing-Hopf endpoint of the Cartan route). This exact declaration is intentionally absent.
